components.name: Journey Bar
components.description: Stages drawn to real seconds: solid ink done, hatched in progress, cross-hatched in conflict.

narrative.overview:
The console is a printer's exposure record of a shoot. Every pipeline stage is a step on one tonal ramp, every photo is a print with measured readings beneath it, and state is carried by tone and hatching rather than by coloured badges. A photo darkens toward zone 0 as it develops from the scorer into Lightroom; the dark theme is the same ramp read in reverse.

The surface is paper and ink: a pale warm-grey ground, black 1px rules, square corners, condensed tracked capitals for legends and tabular monospace for every quantity. The only colour in the system is a dichroic magenta that marks selection and focus. Load and conflict are drawn as hatching in dedicated strips and swatches, never behind words, and every hatch pattern is explained by an on-screen key.

Density is that of a ruled ledger: compact rows, generous paper between bursts, photos large enough to judge. Calm is the default; a conflict changes ink weight and pattern, and is stated in words in the status sentence, so it never depends on colour.
keyCharacteristics: An eleven-step zone ramp (0 to X) is the only neutral scale; tone carries stage.
Hatching is the state layer: diagonal density for load, 90° cross-hatch for conflict.
One accent, dichroic magenta, reserved for selection and focus.
Prints sit in a black mask; rejects are held back in a dashed outline.
Readings are deltas against a reference frame, in thirds of a stop.
Square corners, 1px ink rules, condensed tracked caps for names, tabular mono for measurements.

rules.name: The Zone Ramp Rule
rules.body: Tone carries state. Every neutral comes from zone-0 through zone-10; the only off-ramp values are the sheet paper, the dark-theme mask black and the hatch inks, each with the single job named above.

rules.name: The Dichroic Filter Rule
rules.body: Magenta appears only on selection (including the 1px hover preview of a print's selection outline), `:focus-visible` and `:active`. It never marks a stage, a bucket, a reading or an error.

rules.name: The Inverted Ramp Rule
rules.body: The dark theme is the ramp inverted, not a new palette: ground, ink, rules and stage bands swap ends of the same eleven steps.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Names are condensed tracked capitals; measurements and identifiers are Red Hat Mono. Every figure is tabular (tnum is on globally); the only large numerals, stage counts, are condensed Archivo.

rules.name: The Thirds Rule
rules.body: Exposure readings are deltas against the burst's reference frame (the best, or a stand-in until decided), rounded to thirds of a stop: the sign is always shown (+, −, ± for zero) and the fraction is set as n⁄3 at .86em. Sharpness deltas are signed to two decimals. The reference frame itself reads "ref" with its absolute values.

rules.name: The Developing Ramp Rule
rules.body: Stages read left to right as one ramp: Scoring (zone VIII), Burst window (VI), Publishing (III), In Lightroom (0). Each cell carries an 8px band in its zone tone across its top and its zone numeral in mono at the right of its legend; in dark the tones invert (II, IV, VII, X) while the numerals keep their names.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest casts a shadow. Separation is a rule, a tone step or the black mask.

rules.name: The Hatch Rule
rules.body: Hatching lives only in dedicated strips and swatches, never under text. Diagonal hatching at 135° is load, in three densities (10px, 6px and 3px period) in hatch ink; a 45° plus 135° cross-hatch in full ink is conflict (retrying or not published). The same two patterns appear in the stage load strip, the key, the status alert mark, a print's conflict line and the journey bar.

rules.name: The Mask Rule
rules.body: A photo is never hatched or tinted. It sits in a black mask (3px; 4px on the record's large print). A reject is held back: no mask, a 1px dashed outline in secondary ink, the photo at 70% opacity.

dos: **Do** take every neutral from the zone ramp and let tone say where a photo is.
**Do** draw load and conflict with the two hatch patterns, in their own strip or swatch, and keep the key visible wherever they appear.
**Do** set readings, values and identifiers in Red Hat Mono, keep every figure tabular, and give every exposure reading as a signed delta in thirds of a stop.
**Do** put photos in the black mask and hold rejects back with the dashed outline.
**Do** say a conflict in words as well as pattern: the status sentence and the print's location line name it.
donts: **Don't** introduce coloured badges, traffic-light pills or a second accent; state is tone, pattern and words.
**Don't** use magenta for anything but selection, focus and press.
**Don't** place hatching behind text or over a photo.
**Don't** round corners or add shadows to resting surfaces.
**Don't** shrink photos to row icons; a print stays at least 146px wide.
